tasks.title: Stall speed
tasks.statement: A wing with a mass of **{m} kg**, area **{s} dm²**, C_L,max = **{cl}**. Find the stall speed (m/s) at ρ = 1.225.
tasks.solution: V_s = √(2·m·g/(ρ·S·C_L,max)), S in m² (dm² ÷ 100). Pick cruise 1.3–1.5 times higher.

tasks.title: Wing loading
tasks.statement: Mass **{m} kg**, wing area **{s} dm²**. Find the wing loading (g/dm²).
tasks.solution: W/S = m/S. Below 30 g/dm² is a slow trainer, 60–100 is a fast wing with a hard landing.
